Anatomy

  3. 3.dr-grouptab__countThe count: an 18px pill, 6 after the label, 11/600, --bg-accent-tint behind --text-primary, 14.75:1. It is the tab's own text, so the accessible name is Incoming 2.

When to use

In-page tabs say which of these inside one screen: a row of places with one current. The pill row switches the operator's job list between Incoming and Active (2 pages) and the time-slot list between days (4 pages); the radio form picks a service on the finder (4 pages). The tab bar of the screen shell is the top-level navigation; this row never is.

The current pill is a fill, so it is a second solid-green control on its screen: 99.7 × 32, 1.05% of the frame. On the finder that sits beside the green Find by the designer's choice. Its mark is 1.41:1 against the idle pill, under WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1; it leans on the label moving 5.51 → 9.46 as well. That is recorded as the designer's choice of the accent over the --ink reading (13.33:1). Weight stays 600 (--type-weight-medium) in both states so the current tab does not grow.

Labels are short nouns in sentence case, one name per service everywhere: Delivery, Photo & video, Inspection. Two declared shapes are not drawn here. The underline tab (.dr-groups--tabs) left the product with the category row on listings and is declared at zero spend. .dr-fchip--all is declared and no page applies it. No screen builds either now.

Rule and anti-rule

Do

One list, several slices of it, one current: the row sits directly above the content it switches.

Don’t

Order Activity Help Account

The app's top-level places drawn as in-page pills. HIG · Tab bars reserves those for the bottom tab bar. To pick one option of a form value, use a picker row or choice cards (the segmented control was retired for the picker row at rev 235); to show applied filters, use the chip, not a pill row.
